groups.name: Software delivery
groups.description: From rough requirements to an implemented, verified workpack.

collections.name: pstack
collections.author: Lauren Tan (poteto)
collections.subtitle: Lauren Tan (poteto)
collections.summary: Six verification skills selected from pstack, copied unchanged.

groups.name: Real-app verification
groups.description: Checks observable behavior by launching and driving the running application, and keeps evidence.

groups.name: Formal verification
groups.description: Checks stated properties with models or formal tools, under explicit assumptions and bounds. Uses Statechart for TLA+.

groups.name: Model exploration
groups.description: Explores a TLA+ model and shows transitions and violation paths. Used by the formal pair.

groups.name: Repeated mistakes
groups.description: Changes the repository so a class of mistake can’t recur.

collections.note: The real-app and formal pairs complement each other; they are not interchangeable. A passing model doesn’t prove the shipped app matches it.
beforeInstalling: Some instructions assume Cursor’s .cursor/skills/ location and agent, app-driving or GitHub capabilities.
The maintenance skills change only verification artifacts unless separately authorized to change product code.

collections.name: Emil Kowalski
collections.author: Emil Kowalski
collections.subtitle: UI and animation skills
collections.summary: UI and animation skills, archived as complete upstream directories.

groups.name: Motion
groups.description: Find where motion helps, build it, audit it, review it, or remove it. Animate calls Pick UI library when a component needs one.

groups.name: Interface
groups.description: Stress-test, polish and adapt interfaces for phones.

collections.note: Emil’s own prototype skill isn’t archived: Matt Pocock’s prototype already uses that name, and names must be unique.

beforeInstalling: Needs subagents on three different providers' models (T3 Code's delegate_task, or a harness that runs them). It reports a missing provider instead of substituting one.

statechart.name: Statechart
statechart.summary: Explore a TLA+ model and show the paths that break its rules

maintain-verification-skill.summary: Re-run every mapped feature live and repair the verification harness
maintain-verification-skill.useWhen: Code has changed and an existing real-app verification skill may be out of date.
